body.name: \(\mathsf{Handle}_{\mathrm{cert}}\)
body.def: The pilot-split support-cluster, covariance-rank, and simplex-face architecture realized by \(\mathrm{def:pilot\mbox{-}split\mbox{-}certified\mbox{-}radius}\), with primitive confidence regions, a certified nuisance supremum, explicit error budgets, deterministic work bound, and DKW fallback.
